requirement: A guest cancelling before the stated deadline gets the entire amount paid back as money, with no retained fee.
meaning_constraints: All money returned to original payment/card/bank method; no fee. Can state a cancellation deadline, but assume guest cancels before it.

clauses.text: If you need to adjust your stay dates prior to the final day, a full reimbursement will be issued directly to the original payment source without any penalty charges.
clauses.rationale: Explicitly states full refund to original payment method with no fee, suitable for an FAQ format.

clauses.text: Should your travel plans change before the designated cutoff date, please be advised that we facilitate a complete refund back to your card on file, with no service charges deducted.
clauses.rationale: Written in the persuasive, advisory tone of a travel agent email, confirming a full refund process.

clauses.text: cancellation up to 7 days out: 100% credit issued; funds returned directly to the purchase card.
clauses.rationale: Concise, structured language typical of rate plan footnotes, specifying no charge.

clauses.text: For cancellations made before the departure date, all monies paid will be refunded in full to the method used for booking.
clauses.rationale: Formal, confirmation-style language used to reiterate terms upon booking completion.

clauses.text: Guests who withdraw their booking before the specified date are entitled to a full reimbursement processed back to the originating bank account.
clauses.rationale: Adopting the formal, comprehensive tone of a supplier's general terms and conditions.

clauses.text: Should cancellation occur prior to the due date, the initial booking cost is returned entirely to the payer's account. No forfeiture applies.
clauses.rationale: Mimics the small print found in brochures, using somewhat dense, legally-tinged phrasing.

clauses.text: If you cancel early, the full payment amount comes back to your card—no deductions made.
clauses.rationale: Very direct, informal, and reassuring tone suitable for a quick digital support response.

clauses.text: If you cancel ahead of time, the entire balance will be returned to the original payment source. There are no retention fees.
clauses.rationale: Simple, clear phrasing intended for a general audience reading plain language summaries.

clauses.text: Any applicable charges are voided if notification of cancellation is received before departure, with funds credited to the source method.
clauses.rationale: Presented within a list of available inclusions or features, treating refunds as a positive benefit.

clauses.text: Modifications before the deadline result in the full payment amount being returned to the original card. See policy for details.
clauses.rationale: Language used when amending or adjusting existing bookings, focusing on the reimbursement trigger.

clauses.text: Cancellation within the window: Receive a full credit directly back to your financial institution from the initial payment method.
clauses.rationale: Notice from a specialized service provider, emphasizing the mechanism of the return to the bank.

clauses.text: Cancellation before the cutoff date: Full money returned to original payment method; zero penalty.
clauses.rationale: Short, highly summarized format suitable for comparison against other options in a table.
